description: PB-88 is the Regional Transport Office (RTO) serving the Bhikhiwind sub-division in the Tarn Taran district of Punjab. It functions under the authority of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) to handle vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for this border region.
address: SDM Office Complex, Bhikhiwind, District Tarn Taran, Punjab
